messages.text:
Оставайтесь верны консенсусу: обновите Nexa Full-Node до версии 2.2.0.0

Nexa продолжает совершенствовать протокол, и мы советуем всем обновить свои клиентские приложения для узлов до последней версии.

Эта версия включает в себя скользящие контрольные точки. Как только блок достигает 200-й позиции в цепочке, узел помечает его как завершенный. С этой позиции он считается окончательно утвержденным, и любая реорганизация после этой точки отклоняется.

Для бирж и сервисов это означает нечто конкретное: после 200 подтверждений транзакцию нельзя отменить.

Это также последний релиз перед предстоящим хардфорком и активацией протокола Tailstorm. Важно оставаться верными консенсусу и обновить свои клиенты. 👇

https://nexa.org/node
messages.translation:
Stay true to consensus: update your Nexa Full-Node to version 2.2.0.0

Nexa keeps improving the protocol, and we advise everyone to update their node client applications to the latest version.

This release includes rolling checkpoints. Once a block reaches position 200 in the chain, the node marks it as finalized. From that position on it is considered irreversibly confirmed, and any reorganization past that point is rejected.

For exchanges and services this means something concrete: after 200 confirmations a transaction cannot be reversed.

This is also the last release before the upcoming hard fork and the activation of the Tailstorm protocol. It's important to stay true to consensus and update your clients. 👇

https://nexa.org/node

messages.text:
Аппаратное ускорение: масштабирование с помощью схемы.

Во второй статье этой серии была создана система проверки транзакций Nexa из шести компонентов, ленты и головки, и было показано, как она успешно обрабатывает платеж от Алисы к Бобу без использования какого-либо программного обеспечения.

Поскольку лента двигалась только в одном направлении, система смогла выполнить первое из четырех условий, которые должна удовлетворять улучшенная версия Bitcoin: она была пригодна для конвейерной обработки.

В этой статье мы покажем, как выполнить остальные условия. Как продемонстрировал главный научный сотрудник Nexa, доктор Питер Ризун (@PeterRizun), в Сиднее, мы можем исправить Bitcoin, созданный Сатоши, и заставить его соответствовать всем этим требованиям, внеся всего три простых изменения. Кроме того, в процессе работы система приобретает еще два свойства: расширяемость и сжимаемость, практически без дополнительных затрат.

https://forum.nexa.org/t/scaling-by-circuit/1749
messages.translation:
Hardware acceleration: scaling by circuit.

The second article in this series built a Nexa transaction verification system out of six components, a tape and a head, and showed how it successfully processes a payment from Alice to Bob without using any software at all.

Since the tape only moved in one direction, the system was able to satisfy the first of the four conditions an improved version of Bitcoin must meet: it was suitable for pipelining.

In this article we show how to satisfy the remaining conditions. As Nexa's chief scientist Dr. Peter Rizun (@PeterRizun) demonstrated in Sydney, we can fix the Bitcoin that Satoshi built and make it meet all of these requirements with just three simple changes. On top of that, in the process the system gains two more properties: extensibility and compressibility, at virtually no extra cost.

https://forum.nexa.org/t/scaling-by-circuit/1749

summary.headline: Community-built prediction site, a modest NEXA price rally, and node 2.2.0.0 / Tailstorm fork talk
summary.summary: Over roughly ten days the Russian Nexa group mixed light community projects with price and protocol discussion. Woldemar Kulachesko and Alex ▼ promoted a free, no-stakes Premier League prediction site that uses Wally wallet login, and Alex ▼ quickly added CS2 and Dota sections at High Voltage's suggestion. The bigger thread was price: after Max complained growth had stalled, Лил, Sergey Ionov, Bossmen and Woldemar Kulachesko debated whether a real rally had begun, whether whales/ASIC miners would dump again (Bossmen noting there are no buy walls below), and whether NEXA can reclaim old highs — with some jokes that such prices might take 40 years. Лил raised harder questions about whether only die-hard fans remain and whether the project will survive, while Bossmen argued the team at least hasn't rugged. Blacktea ▽ posted the official announcement for Full-Node 2.2.0.0 with rolling checkpoints (200-block finality), the last release before the Tailstorm hard fork, plus a Peter Rizun 'scaling by circuit' article. That triggered a technical exchange in which Woldemar Kulachesko and Alex ▼ explained GPUs stay, old ASICs become obsolete, and a Game-of-Life-based changing algorithm would make ASICs inefficient.

topics.summary: Max flagged stalled growth; Sergey Ionov, Woldemar Kulachesko, Лил and Bossmen then discussed a slow climb off the bottom, deposits near 2x, missing buy walls, fear of another whale/ASIC dump, and how long a return to old highs could take.

topics.title: Node 2.2.0.0, Tailstorm and mining hardware
topics.summary: Blacktea ▽ announced the Full-Node 2.2.0.0 release with rolling checkpoints and the upcoming Tailstorm hard fork; Oleg, Sergey Ionov, Woldemar Kulachesko and Alex ▼ debated whether mining shifts to ASICs, concluding GPUs remain and a changing, Game-of-Life-based algorithm would make ASICs inefficient.

topics.title: Community Premier League prediction site
topics.summary: Woldemar Kulachesko shared a free, payment-free predictions site built by Alex ▼ with Wally wallet login; High Voltage asked for Dota and CS variants and Alex ▼ added CS2 and Dota within days, with a 50-euro prize mentioned.

topics.title: Project viability and trust in the team
topics.summary: Лил wondered whether only true fans remain, who the big holders are, and whether Nexa will survive like BTC; Bossmen said the devs at least never rugged and speculated they dumped the price to buy cheaper, while Woldemar Kulachesko confirmed the BU/BCH link.

topics.title: MEXC login trouble
topics.summary: Лил couldn't receive SMS codes on MEXC and had forgotten the account email; Woldemar Kulachesko suggested support or waiting, and Лил eventually got in via password plus Google Authenticator, then asked what a passkey is.

topics.title: Where to buy Nexa
topics.summary: Woldemar Kulachesko and Д. Н. triggered the Rose bot's /buy exchange list; Woldemar Kulachesko also dropped a NexaMoney X post.

summary.mood_description: The tone is light and bantering throughout — gaming-prediction jokes, self-deprecating 'nobody buys the bottom' remarks, and laughter about price targets taking 40 years. Underneath there is genuine cautious optimism as Nexa grinds upward, mixed with real anxiety from Bossmen about missing buy walls and a repeat of the ASIC miners' big dump, and existential doubt from Лил about whether the project will ever take off. The official node 2.2.0.0 / Tailstorm announcement lifts the mood into constructive technical curiosity near the end, even if Sergey Ionov admits he understands little of it.

highlights.why: Official announcement: Full-Node 2.2.0.0 with 200-block rolling checkpoints, the last release before the Tailstorm hard fork.
Bossmen's crude, funny reply to being teased about his 'depression' over the price — a chat-defining moment.
Concrete market concern: the rally has no buy walls beneath it, so whales could dump.
Alex ▼ explains the planned Game-of-Life-based changing algorithm would make ASICs inefficient, countering the ASIC-transition assumption.
Лил's blunt take that only die-hard fans remain and the majority bailed long ago, framing the project-survival debate.
